## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle Suí–early-Táng commentary on the *Sìfēnlǜ* 四分律 ([KR6k0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0001)) by **Fǎlì** 法礪 ([法礪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%A4%AA), 569–635), the founding patriarch of the **Xiāngbù** 相部 school of Tang Vinaya exegesis. The work is the foundational treatise of one of the three competing Tang Vinaya schools (*Xiāngbù* / *Nánshān* / *Dōngtǎ*).

**Abstract**

Fǎlì's *Shū* is the senior of the three principal Tang *Sìfēnlǜ* commentaries, predating Dàoxuān's ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Xíngshì chāo* and *Suíjī jiémó shū* by a generation. Where Dàoxuān's works are practical-pedagogical and oriented to monastic conduct, Fǎlì's *Shū* is a doctrinal-philosophical exposition keyed to the conceptual structure of the *Sìfēn* in the manner inherited from his teachers in the late-Suí Vinaya tradition. The *Xiāngbù* school's distinctive doctrinal positions — including its analysis of the *jiètǐ* 戒體 ("substance of the precepts") in non-*Mahāyāna* terms, in contrast to Dàoxuān's *yuánjiào* 圓教 reading — are systematically argued here. Fǎlì's chief disciple **Dìng Bīn** 定賓 ([定賓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%9A%E8%B3%93)) produced the principal sub-commentary, [KR6k0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0163) *Sìfēnlǜ shū shìzōng yìjì*. The *Xiāngbù* school flourished into the early Tang but was gradually displaced by the *Nánshān* tradition; Fǎlì's *Shū* survives as our principal direct witness to the *Xiāngbù* doctrinal position.
